review_scope: Read-only source review of official Spot PhysX scene, original navigation preparation, native LiDAR phase, exact sensor pairing, static floor contact, dynamic veto and actual full-body geometry; no ROS, Kit or Git invocation.
reviewed_servo_baseline: bounded_measured_body_velocity_PI_v1 reviewed before pending v3 physical stop and low-speed validation; current source hashes are an audit-time inventory, not a final v27 candidate seal.

reviewed_contracts.result: Explicit sealed prephysics BEGIN phase retains actual capture pose and original native END frame time; native physics-step and finite dt checks reject mismatches.
Static prior queries require matching front/rear integrated source stamps and finite original source/receipt leases. No time-budget relaxation was found in the reviewed chain.
Support-contact cells are isolated-simulation opt-in, intersect the certified plane and exclude closed nonfloor static solids plus margin; nonfloor hit contradictions remain vetoes.

Complete registered same-step measured actor snapshots add a reachable occupancy veto. The 6 s reachable geometry horizon does not replace the 200 ms source/receipt freshness limits. C1 actor trajectory speed/acceleration bounds and persistent presence are validated.
Self-hit removal uses actual registered collider solids; full measured articulated bounds must fit the collision query envelope. Missing, changed or out-of-envelope geometry revokes evidence.

pending_validation.evidence: The parent-run 0.01 m/s physical probe traveled only about 0.0312 m in 20 source seconds. The reviewed PI baseline retains nonzero integral at exactly zero desired and measured velocity (quadruped.py:63-68); source behavior alone does not establish a physical stop violation. Pending v3 changes and measured stop/response must be assessed before sealing the candidate.
Source review does not establish goal completion, dynamic obstacle avoidance, measured stop, LIO localization performance, physical SDK behavior or deployment acceptance.

evidence_label_status: Current smoke.py uses PhysX_robot_fixture; earlier v26 wheel-fixture test_scope is historical labeling and must not be used to identify the current robot.
limitations: Review findings are limited to inspected current source and do not certify all possible defects.
Source files may change after this inventory; recompute hashes and repeat relevant verification for the final candidate.
